title: skills: platform-catalog lists the built-in sys_task and sys_note objects
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

## What

PR #36965 (card #36942) ships two built-in platform objects, `sys_task` and `sys_note` (`packages/platform-objects/src/work/`), registered as platform-provided in `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts`, with `member_default` granting read, create and edit (no delete) by the maintainer's ruling 7131539862 (option A).

`skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` — the section "Platform objects an app would otherwise build" — lists neither. An agent building an app that needs tasks or notes will author its own `task` / `note` objects instead of using the platform's.

## Expected

- Add `sys_task` and `sys_note` to that catalog section: what each holds (task: title, assignee, status, due date, completion stamp; note: title, body), that they carry no relation to a business record in this first step (#36941's scope), that row visibility is private (a task to its creator and assignee; a note to its creator) and `member_default` opens the objects without widening rows, and the listViews shipped (`assigned_to_me`, `created_by_me`, `all`).
- One eval case in the skill's evals: an app that needs to-dos uses `sys_task`, not a new object.
- Read the merged code, not this card, for every fact; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; `skills/**` is governed — land by the low-risk skills arm if it qualifies, else hand to the seat.

Blocked-by: #36942

Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card (a skills teaching gap that follows a shipped capability)`
